blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Port Moody Centre fell from 21 in June to 15 in September, and 9 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 11.1% of Port Moody’s 135 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Port Moody Centre?
Port Moody Centre also had 120 condos and townhomes listed and 16 sold in September, against 15 houses listed. The Port Moody Centre condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed in Port Moody Centre. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Port Moody Centre had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Port Moody Centre from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Port Moody Centre over those 4 months, out of 51 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
